description: (0.5.0) A retraction of an ancestor accepted (event receipt accepted_at) after T. As of T the event is not admitted; latest admits it. retracted is a caveat, not a refusal (RFC-ACDP-0017 §7.8, §8.1, §10).

acdp://registry.example.com/aaaaaaaa-aaa.node_verdict: ok_with_caveats (A's own verdict is NOT tainted by B, RFC-ACDP-0017 §8.3)

scenarios.name: B — event with no receipt, attested events required

expected.behavior: Drop event_receipts. As of T the event has no evidence time and is not admitted; since no admitted event follows it, the prefix is empty and retraction is not_retracted. Latest admits the producer-signed event (signature verifies): retracted. Drift retracted_after_as_of.

scenarios.name: C — unreceipted event followed by a receipted one

expected.behavior: Events [retracted (no receipt), republished (receipt accepted_at < T)]: as of T the unadmitted event precedes an admitted one, so retraction is unknown (RFC-ACDP-0017 §7.8 item 3) and the node as-of verdict is unknown.

notes: Behavioral in this Draft: the verifier builds the described bundle from real signed bodies (or the rcpt-001 / sig-003 test keys), runs verify_chain, and asserts the pinned stage values and verdicts. Pinned verdict digests replace these assertions at promotion (RFC-ACDP-0017 §14).
